segments.ja162:1.1: Na santhavasmā paramatthi pāpiyo, yo santhavo [sandhavo (ka.)] kāpurisena hoti;
segments.ja162:1.3: Santappito sappinā pāyasena [pāyāsena (ka.)], kicchākataṃ paṇṇakuṭiṃ adayhi [adaḍḍhahi (sī. syā.), adaṭṭhahi (pī.), adaddahi (?)].
segments.ja162:2.1: Na santhavasmā paramatthi seyyo, yo santhavo sappurisena hoti;
segments.ja162:2.3: Sīhassa byagghassa ca dīpino ca, sāmā mukhaṃ lehati santhavenāti.
